design.information: model, rates and calibration at each E use only rows received by E; calibration dependencyAvailableAt <= E is asserted
design.conditional: skaters scored on realized appearances, goalies on realized starts (if-playing / if-starting bands)
design.baseline: Poisson (counts) or Bernoulli (WIN, SHUTOUT) equal-tail bands around the same kernel mean
design.intervalScore: Winkler: width + (2/alpha) * shortfall below + (2/alpha) * excess above; lower is better
design.horizon: k-th game of the player's team after the cutoff (team schedule, regular season)

rule.candidateCells: goalie 90% at H1-H7, per category x horizon
rule.criterion: one-sided 95% bootstrap upper bound (95th percentile of resampled means) of the mean paired interval-score difference, candidate minus baseline, per distinct start, below 0

holdout.note: outcomes after the selection data; daily cutoffs
